note: FORNAMN/EFTERNAMN are the same-shape pair that groups in siblings-only-same-shape-non-code-label-siblings-form-a-group. Here the efternamn variable holds two spellings: EFTERNAMN alone in 2019, and Efternamn twice in the same 2020 edition as FORNAMN, once as int and once as text, so its latest shape is disputed: one reading groups the pair, the other does not. Only Efternamn, the spelling that sorts after EFTERNAMN, is co-delivered with FORNAMN (#1760, the DatOvl_2/DATOVL_2 case). Values from the replaced test: A int (member 1), B int (member 2), B text (member 3) -> no pairs and an unresolved_shape decision. The decision is reported as the ambiguous_sibling_shape issue; that code is the one the replaced file's withheld-shape test asserts for the same emission. The conflicting_occurrence_facts and unknown_data_type errors on Efternamn are the delivery's own and are not claimed.
fails_if: `resolve_sibling_pairs` (reg_meta_build/src/reg_meta_build/source_siblings.py) only marks a pair unresolved when a shape field is withheld, not when equally recent shapes disagree, or checks co-delivery and shape on one representative column per owner (the lexically first, EFTERNAMN, never co-delivered with FORNAMN), so FORNAMN/efternamn group

sources.description: Register 1, variable 300: EFTERNAMN (CVID 1007, int) in 2019; FORNAMN (CVID 1004, int), Efternamn (CVID 1005, int) and Efternamn again (CVID 1006, Sträng (text)) in 2020.
